assumptions.choice: size = floor(1% of broker.getvalue() / current close price), i.e. whole-share size computed from total portfolio value
assumptions.reason: spec states each position must be sized at 1% of 'total trading capital', which is read as current portfolio value (broker.getvalue()); fractional shares are not available so the share count is truncated to an integer

assumptions.choice: used bt.indicators.CrossOver(data.close, sma) with >0 signaling close crossing above the SMA (entry) and <0 signaling close crossing below the SMA (death cross exit)
assumptions.reason: directly implements the literal 'crosses from below to above' / 'crosses from above to below' language in the spec

assumptions.choice: only one position open at a time; no new entry while a position is active
assumptions.reason: canonical default since spec does not address multiple concurrent positions
spec explicitly states no stop-loss is used
